name: Delaware River at Callicoon, NY
tagline: The upper Delaware's main stem, fed by the East and West Branches below Pepacton and Cannonsville reservoirs.
about: The upper Delaware at Callicoon drains 1,820 square miles of the western Catskills and the Pocono edge. New York City's Cannonsville and Pepacton reservoirs capture most of the East and West Branch headwaters, so summer flow and water temperature depend on scheduled releases as much as on rain. Water takes two to four days to travel from the headwaters to the gauge, which is why multi-day forecasts are possible here.
